thread:
alex: morning — quick async standup. Done: rolled a small routing fix for /v2/predict that was mis-tagging buckets. Blocker: intermittent 429s in staging on bursts. Today: will tweak rate policy and pair with @maria for a controlled canary.

maria: saw the 429s earlier. logs point to token-bucket exhaustion on pool-3 nodes. I bumped staging token capacity briefly to repro, will revert after test.

casey: reviewed alex's PR #4823 — one nit about header passthrough but otherwise LGTM. can approve after small change.

jin: auth update — rotated the analytics-worker service key (no impact). Also found an expired KID on jwt-issuer in eu-west; patching now.

sam: FYI I put together a lightweight smoke runner that does bursts (120 rps w/ spikes) to exercise batching and token buckets. run link: https://ci.internal/runs/599

deploy-bot: deploy queued -> staging: infra/2026-03-18-gw-rate-tweak by alex.

alex: here is the staging rate policy I applied as a quick test:
```json
{
  "route": "/v2/predict",
  "limit": 1000,
  "burst": 3000,
  "window_ms": 60000
}
```

maria: can we reduce burst to 2000 and enable gradual ramp (10% per minute) to avoid cold-node overload? also enable per-token metrics for 24h.

alex: ok dropping burst -> 2000 and adding ramp. pairing in ~20m. @casey can you eyeball the CR after I push the change?

casey: will do, should be quick.

jin: copying a short log snippet from pool-3 during the spike:
```
[03:12:14] pool-3 node-7 token-delta -1200
[03:12:15] pool-3 node-7 429  /v2/predict
```

alex: plan: push config change -> run sam's smoke test -> monitor metrics (latency, 429s, per-token cost) for 24h. if stable, schedule canary -> prod promotion tomorrow AM.

sam: standing by, will run the smoke and post run results. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — also adding a short alert temporarily for >1% 429s on /v2/predict across staging so we catch regressions fast.

alex: closing loop — no other blockers from me.
